requests.ask: BT-04a's done_when wires its test into tools/check_all.sh, which is not in the task's files. Add, in the candidate that merges BT-04a, after the line 'python3 tools/ui_gate/sheet.py --self-test' in the section '== the UI wave gate's sheets and image checks, with their planted fails (AD-R3) ==', the line: python3 tools/gate/render.py --self-test . It runs the shot list's parser tests and the build cache's fallback test, then renders the fixture item 'settings at 200% text, pt_BR' (tools/gate/fixtures/test_shots.json) at the candidate's HEAD, exported with git archive into a temporary folder. Under run_checks.sh's sandbox the cache falls back to the run's private /tmp (HOME is read-only), so that line costs one cargo build of the GDExtension per run: about 5 min on 4 cores; outside the sandbox the cache under ~/.cache/ruleborn/gate stays warm (about 15 s). Where Godot, xvfb-run or cargo is absent it prints 'render.py: SKIPPED the fixture render: <why>' and still runs the other tests.
requests.default: the lead adds that one line, as above, in the candidate that merges BT-04a (as it did for AD-R3 and K1-R1)
